elements.element: Services are warranted to be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner.
elements.evidence: Clause 9(a) expressly warrants that the Hosting Services, Support Services, and other agreed-upon services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner.

elements.element: Deliverables or software are warranted to conform to their documentation.
elements.evidence: Clause 9(b) warrants that the Interface and all related software will conform in all material respects to its documentation and specifications.

elements.element: The software conformance warranty lasts 12 months.
elements.evidence: The software conformance warranty applies for twelve months following the Effective Date.
Hosting Services and Support Services are warranted to conform to their contractual descriptions for ninety days following performance.

elements.element: Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.
elements.evidence: The remedies expressly include re-performance, repair, or replacement, although selection is at TrueLink's option.
The remedies expressly include a refund of fees paid for the non-conforming software or services, although selection is at TrueLink's option.

elements.element: Vendor warrants compliance with applicable laws.
elements.evidence: TrueLink warrants that it will comply in all material respects with all laws applicable to its performance under the Agreement.

elements.element: Vendor warrants that the Services and Deliverables contain no malicious code.
elements.evidence: The malicious-code warranty covers only the Interface and related software; it does not expressly cover the Hosting Services, Support Services, other services, or all Deliverables.

elements.element: Software is warranted to conform to its documentation for at least 90 days.
elements.evidence: The Interface and related software are warranted to conform to documentation and specifications for twelve months, exceeding 90 days.

elements.element: Services are warranted for at least 30 days.
elements.evidence: Hosting Services and Support Services are warranted to conform to their contractual descriptions for ninety days following performance, exceeding 30 days.

elements.element: Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.
elements.evidence: The remedies expressly include re-performance, repair, or replacement, at TrueLink's option.
The remedies expressly include a refund of fees paid for non-conforming software or services, at TrueLink's option.
